Edit your Canva designs without an internet connection. Work offline, then sync your changes when you're back online.

Get started with offline editing

Before you start working offline, you'll need to set things up while you're online.

Supported devices

Chrome, Edge, or Safari (desktop browsers)
Firefox (versions below 149)
Canva desktop app
Android app
Mobile browsers

Not supported:

iOS and iPad apps
Firefox (versions 149 and above)
Private or incognito mode
Before you go offline

Make sure you understand these key limits before working offline:

You must make your designs available offline first.
Designs enabled for offline are available on the device only, and won’t be available on other devices.
You can only edit existing designs (no new designs offline)
Some features won’t work without internet.
Your changes are saved locally on your device.
You can work offline for up to 14 days.
Don’t sign out while online, this removes offline designs.
